subject: promotion gate: flip learned model to primary judge when agreement_rate > threshold
description: Config-driven promotion gate. Config (.graph/edge-clf/config.json): { threshold: 0.92, window: 100, fallback_conf: 0.7 }. When agreement_rate (from task #5) exceeds threshold on a sustained window of held-out verdicts, flip the judge role: learned model becomes primary, Sonnet becomes shadow + OOD fallback. OOD fallback: if learned model confidence < fallback_conf, route to Sonnet. Write the current mode (sonnet-primary | learned-primary) to .graph/edge-clf/mode.json. The flip is logged as a decision note in the graph. Blocked by agreement rate metric (task #5).
